reviews_data.review_text: Love the cake and pastries

reviews_data.review_text: Dessert options are exceptional and tasty. Many items are sold out .

It was a wonderful experience! I got a grilled cheese and they happily reheated it using their oven. Although most of it was sold out and/bc we came later , it was still great quality. I also got a mint lemonade fantastic flavor, same for the s’more cake/macadamia cookie . Service and atmosphere were excellent!!!

reviews_data.review_text: Great experience! The restuarant was clean with a great atomosphere. reviews_data.review_text: Mid tbh. Music inside was way too loud, food was just ok. I was particularly disappointed by the "cream cheese puff" which was, like everything from the displays, stone cold, but also entirely hollow (see picture).

reviews_data.review_text: Hot take I didn’t like the food at all. It definitely tasted low quality and in my opinion looked low quality too. Definitely not traditional French pastries. I will say it was a lot more inexpensive than I thought it would be, and they have a wide variety. I really wasn’t a fan of the buffet style especially with the hot food. reviews_data.review_text: When you walk in there are trays and tongs set up for self-service. Their uniforms send a positive message and the staff is patient with you and caters to however you would like your order. Most definitely nice for a treat or a lil coffee date where you can enjoy your goods out by the fireplace or fountain in the courtyard.
reviews_data.owner_answer: Thank you for your review, Tahnja! We're happy to hear you enjoyed our setup, delicious offerings, and patient staff. We look forward to welcoming you back for another treat or coffee date soon!

reviews_data.review_text:
I saw some online ads for this place and everything looked good, even the sandwiches. Unfortunately, my experience wasn't great.

The parking spaces are far away from the building so it's going to be a bit of a walk for anyone with mobility issues. The place looked pristine from the outside. When you enter, most of the pastries are behind glass. There are instructions that say grab a tray, place a piece of wax paper on it, grab a pair of tongs, select your items, and leave the tongs on the tray. It sounded good since people aren't using the same tongs, but the trays were all wet and most had food debris. It looked liked the items are baked fresh, but it also looked like the items are either shipped in or made from corporate mixes. A loaf of sliced whole grain bread had a lot more ingredients than bread from a grocery store.

The sandwiches and salads aren't made to order. They're displayed airport-style and priced almost as high.

The one item I purchased was displayed as $4.99 but rang up as $6.29. I didn't argue it because it was mostly teenagers working who were still learning and it wasn't worth $1.30 to me. The item waa just ok.

There are just too many places that are making fresh sandwiches, bread, and sweets in the area for me to want to go back here (Buzz, Breadsmith, Cupcrazed, Rendebrew).
Employees are very very hard working! They deserve more then minimum wage!! 😤 to all bakers and cakers you all are Amazing keep up the hard work! You have blessing to come!
reviews_data.owner_answer: Thank you for your review, Amanda. We're happy to hear you appreciate our team's hard work, and we'll continue to support them in delivering great service.

reviews_data.review_text: This place is stunning.!!! Staff was the kindest and sweetest. Pastries were absolutely delicious. Best of all my iced chai was amazing.
reviews_data.owner_answer: Thank you for your review! We're happy to hear you enjoyed our stunning place, kind staff, and delicious pastries, especially the iced chai. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!

The whole crew was extremely nice and
Everything we ordered was delicious, including my Americano, you can tell they use quality ingredients! New fav spot 🤩
reviews_data.owner_answer: Thank you for your review, Deysi! We're happy to hear you enjoyed our delicious offerings and found our crew extremely nice. We look forward to welcoming you back to your new favorite spot soon!

reviews_data.review_text: Have come to this location twice and after 5pm it’s as if all work function and restocking of pastries stop. I have been to the flagship in NY and Ballentyne locations and it doesn’t matter when I go I can find there are pastries available in plenty. This location is new but it could really work on how they restock especially with the hours they are opened 6-9pm.
reviews_data.owner_answer: Thank you for your review, Kevin. We're sorry to hear about the restocking issues, and we'll work on improving our inventory management to ensure a better experience. We look forward to serving you better in the future.

reviews_data.review_text:
We were waiting for this store to open for ages, lol!
We went today and couldn’t decide what to get, there were so many pastries and cakes to choose from! We wound up trying each other’s desserts. Each one was as fresh and delicious as the other.
It’s been a long time since we had fresh pastries.
I ordered a frappe. It took a little long to get it, but in the end it was SOOOOOO GOOD, it was worth the wait. We understand they just opened and everyone is new at this. The manager was working along side everyone which was good to see. She was very friendly.
We will be back real soon and will spread the word!
The only negative is the parking isn’t handicap friendly. There are a lot of people with disabilities in the area.
Thank you for a wonderful experience!!!

P.S. - I waved and gave a big thumbs up to the lady’s who were working on the cakes.
They do amazing work!
reviews_data.owner_answer: Thank you for your review, JoAnne! We're happy to hear you enjoyed our fresh pastries and friendly service, and we appreciate your feedback about the parking. We look forward to welcoming you back soon!
